title: Downloads
description: SABnzbd, NZBGet and qBittorrent queues in one place: speed, what's left, and pause or resume.

steps: Copy the address you open SABnzbd at, such as http://sabnzbd.local:8080/.
In SABnzbd, open Config → General and copy the API Key under Security.

credential.label: API key
credential.hint: The API key, not the NZB key: pausing and resuming need it.

steps: Copy the address you open NZBGet at, such as http://nzbget.local:6789/.
Use a username and password from Settings → Security: the control pair or the restricted one.
In qBittorrent, open Tools → Options → Web UI and turn on the Web User Interface.
Copy its address, such as http://qbittorrent.local:8080/, and the username and password set there.

setup.intro: Shows what your download clients are doing: total speed, the queue and what finished. Add one connection for each client.

settings.label: Show recent finishes
settings.help: Completed and failed downloads from the last day, under the queue.

settings.label: Show torrents that are uploading
settings.help: qBittorrent only. Finished torrents still sending to peers.
